{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：星學大成三十卷，明萬民英撰。民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"英字育吾，大寧都司人。嘉靖庚戍進士，厯官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"河南道監察御史，出為福建布政司右參議。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"是編取舊時星學家言，以次編排，間加註釋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"論斷。其一曰星曜圖例；其二曰觀星節要、宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452945845321791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"度主用、十二位論，其三曰諸家限例、琴堂虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"實，其四曰耶律秘訣；其五至七曰仙城望斗、三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"辰通載，其八曰總龜紫府珍藏、星經雜著，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"其九曰碧玉真經、鄧史喬拗，其十曰光矞淵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"微、星曜格局。其於星家古法，纎鉅不遺，可稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"大備。自來言術數者，惟章世純所云：其法有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"驗有不驗。騐者，人之智計所及；不騐者，天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲妙斯存。其言最為𠃔當。而術家必欲事事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452945845305407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"皆騐，故多出其途以測之，途愈多而愈不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"中。其尤難信者，無過於喬廟一説。其説以火、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"土二星相反而相成，晝火參、軫及箕、壁無咎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"乃大告；夜土角、斗及井、奎降福亦如之。不知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之理，惟主生尅，如季土坐於凋零之木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"本自借其疏通；旺火臨於瀺灂之流，亦轉樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"其滋益。若乃冬火坐水鄉，春土居木位，豈可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"目為喬廟而定其吉乎？且土雖盛而木已被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956498673702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"其沈埋，火即熾而水己虞其枯涸，有利於此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"即不利於彼。是皆好竒求騐，而不計五行生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"尅之故者。民英於此𩔖大抵沿襲舊聞，未能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"駁正其謬。且今之五星躔度嵗差，既異於古，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"亦難必其盡合。然其鳩集衆説，多術家不傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"之本，實為五星之大全，與子平之三命通㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"並行不悖。後來言果老術者，參互考證，要必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"於是取資焉。明史藝文志及黄虞稷千頃堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452766945755171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"書目皆以此書為陸位撰，而别出萬民英三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"命會通十二卷。今檢此本卷首自序及凡例，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"確為民英所撰，藝文志葢沿黄氏之誤，故仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"以民英之名著録焉。乾隆四十六年五月恭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"校上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"怪亡神以立身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"騰厄重迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"風。騰煞與夭厄同宫者，大忌之。不宜坐命安身，更限不吉，必主破敗。一空重者主法死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"天妖刄神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"天妖即丁甲金兮丙從火之𩔖，若為煞星，深忌之。空亦刑尅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541606440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"池忌實見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"如咸池煞命主帶之，四柱上又見，深忌之，其人必因色而亡身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"相忌疾親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"相貌宫與疾厄宫，主有相關，及同位互換者，主破相有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"陽不守於四凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"陽者，陽刃也。寅申己亥為四凶之宫，惟辰戌丑未四宫值之偏重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"狗獨嫌於五七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"天狗星嫌居五七之地，在夫妻尅夫妻，在男女尅子女，不尅則亦如途人耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642384447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"産星用二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"此星遇之，男主血光，女主産厄。犯重者凶，輕者亦有血氣之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"帝城則一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"帝城，垣城也。為貴人之地，忌凶煞居之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人遷變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星諸宫遇之則能伏煞，當各論其遷變，必論陰陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"祿神恊吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"禄神者，甲木孛兮乙水星，丙計丁羅是也。作生星則吉，作尅星則凶，用之終不吉也。舊本云催官恊吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541590056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣宜身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰居于生氣上者，主一生無險難事。其例有二月後第三位是也。考通書，合乃生月後，此法可用於小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱宜室，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"戍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"金匱星主妻財，宜居二七位，吉。田宅輕偏，宜妻宫坐之，得妻之財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"刼不利於少年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"刼在命，主少年多滯，老後主有權柄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398934079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"刑主妨於就晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"本宫之星不喜與四柱内相刑，為就晦之禍太重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"坐馬忌衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午戌馬居申之𩔖。如限星坐馬上，忌年衝之，大凶。凡命吉星坐馬上，主機狡乖劣有格者，主五馬之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"如凶星破之，諸星不來，如五馬之害己也。有祿馬壓之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"子妨華盖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"華盖，男女宫忌之，身命亦不宜居之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"六合在全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081453091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"六合者，子與丑合之𩔖。此六合全不空方為合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"互垣宜制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"互垣之星，看其吉凶相制，隨處斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊立業，鎮、水同宫。金牛處命，羅土相從。閑處則吉，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"處則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"如戌上安命，水土偕行，當命限上，則欲作用。酉宫安命，羅土同居亦然。若刃水刃火，最為利害，忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"兎逐鷄窠，龍居犬穴。馬馳䑕道，牛奔羊結。凶可為祥，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"可為孽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398950463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"此言卯酉辰戍、子午丑未二宫之星吉凶如何，用别輕重。反吉為凶，反凶為吉，變化不測。論造化異于常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"人，當口傳心授。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"兎逐雞窠，火入金鄉。龍居犬穴，金入火位。馬馳䑕道，移乾就濕。牛奔羊結，土鎮月宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"借宫則論煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"亥二宫坐命，以寅申水木借用，寅忌土計，申忌土金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘則論絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"金木水火土絶處，如以孛、羅、計作用神行事，吉凶立驗。如神金因絶於寅，而火生於寅。金生在已，火臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"己。金敗午，火旺午。故金無餘氣。金主殺，天道好生，故無餘氣。且水有孛，火有羅，木有炁，土有計，天地閒水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909162550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"土木多，火燃處即多，獨金雖神仙燒煉，亦無有也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"宵中火金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"凡夜生人火星看坐何宫。論空實則大驗。自未至子為陰，自丑至午為陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"晝逢太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"同上，丑至午為陽。此二章論其空實之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"二德相拱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"天德、月德三方拱者至吉。縱然凶，終有救解，無大害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在箕度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223703080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"冬至之日，太陽在箕七八九度，便作下年例之。看前後月之大小，便知其箕之幾度。若上月大，則牛一度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"上月小，則後一度。如二月俱小，則是九度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"身値獨處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰只要獨行。最忌刑衝，則吉凶在目前，淫樂亡敗有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"用在七强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"用者，限元也。起處要臨七强宫，方為得地，隨其制化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"衝處不起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"四殿，拱處伏了諸星，皆實行，則禍福於此最𦂳。可貴可富，可貧可賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398917695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"空處不生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"生我之星空了，諸星不在。取福反取禍。其中凶能致吉，吉反為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"身元極關於命主，四正刑切於三方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"雖三方照主吉，亦主凶。若四柱與命盤中相刑，則𦂳切致禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福先後，歲籍晦明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"命之死生，或應前，或應後。三年者，直年太歲，與人之生時𨵿係，或因衝戰，或三方吊起，以論吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛積聚，水計論量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命中水計同處，或命主或財關係，可致富。己宫立命之人，水計同行，可富可貴可壽，皆在衝尅中之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642400831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"量其或水木、水炁、水日月、水金之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"福自為福，殃處為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文財帛積聚之説言之。福自福，禍自禍，難用推除。此言極當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"驀駕立命，狡性戰爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"如子生人亥宫命，謂之驀駕。其人多狡猾，好與人爭鬬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"生曜逢空，反不為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"坐命處忽有生星至本宫，被魁鬼空了，反不為吉，餘宫减半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"杓宜指禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559554088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"斗杓指祿者驟富，合格令者大貴人也。又須論生尅，則應自生月起，至生時是也。非甲祿在寅者，乃甲人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"用辛為官，辛祿居酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"財宜制尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"財星起處，要尅他宫星，必主富。值空反不為祥。尅他不空為上吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"夾位喜母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"有用處有母曜在内拱夾者妙。如身坐處有吉星拱夾者，亦有變化之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"拱喜時徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"時者，生時也。德者，生年也。年時拱官命財者妙。拱凶者，主為禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399543005222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"三空四空，變化不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"三空者，魁鬼流魁也。四空者，日月時斗空也。與本年者輾轉相關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"囬衝順衝，貧富難容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時相關，衝實衝虚。順衝者，星隨而去之。老人忌衝空之位，雖吉處，他宫亦多災厄，衝則輕也。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上値酉衝行卯年來則云回衝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"五常為吉，二符忌凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"官福田財，身宫主星，皆作吉星論生年病符死符到處，惡星坐其上，限又逢之。作惡星用，主大凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰位，已丑相關。已午未人，申辰欠安。申酉戍中，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471281186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"未翩翻。亥子丑宫，寅戍最難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯辰人，水土之星限見生則為吉。惟夫妻兄弟之中有妨，年月日時亦有相關。己午未生人，或坐命處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"金水二星。申酉戌上，木月二星。亥子丑上，木火二星。命限見之，尅與上同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"坐星生星，尅制非凡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"水木金水、木月木火，雖是生星，但生年與日時命限逢之，富自富，貴自貴，亦須有尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"星宫亂合，宫分偏正，逐兎攀龍，超凡入聖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"炁與羅合，木與日合。凡星坐命，宫分偏正淺深，驗生時之尅制刻數，則行限便知吉凶前後。如行卯限，先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"入乎辰，則吉凶可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392286990386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"以金伐木，猴來則變作權人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"仇土打蛇，猪見乃靑雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"土埋雙女，己上行限，路遇此猪，乃亥星正管限，則有變化之理，平歩可致公卿。若不空不衝，大凶，亥宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。金騎人馬，遇水則轉生木。土埋雙女，遇木則制其難。要不外乎生尅制化之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"直財入庫，富有千金。直祿入官，位居極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"更有田星拱之足祿。如財帛星入庫。水土辰金丑木未火戍。如甲生人，祿在寅，更得命限好，大富宫主又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"作祿神，如祿宫為官宫，若受拱為大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"魁臨學館，主冠世之文章。馬入身元，乃離鄕之傑士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493794853"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"文冠臨於學堂之上者，生平有文學魁世，以文得名聲。馬與身主㑹，離祖成名，身性無定。女人切忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"衆星靜處，不作僧徒，翻作貧人。五星致凶不露，暴流自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"微得著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"五星皆靜而不相生者，一生不能發越，必下等人也。凶人欲行上人之志，立身後欠善終，　一時暴發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶㑹，凡人卽拜公𡖖。命毋犯衝，當路卽為寒士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時同處為實地，平人即為公卿。生我之星謂之毋曜，被衝壊了，在限上不吉，或於他處亦然，終作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"貧寒之士也。詳究之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"命立歲主，配偶犯重。命立破鄉，生意濛濛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223785000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"如子年生人立命子上，則妻必犯重，或生尅逢生，亦主富貴。子生人立命午，則為歲破，必然自權自立，限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"行遇吉星生之，則亦富貴。若又子時生，則管限中亦能反覆其吉凶也。雖吉則七旬上必亡。子上有生星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"重子立命，土木七宫。少者怙恃，長則何庸。寅宫已水，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"日無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文而言，為十二宫網領，有𦂳之吉凶，人心自解。凶為吉，吉為凶，盡在此章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"重卯酉籍，孤苦貧窮。若遇日辰，和氣溶溶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"與上文相𩔖。以六十甲子中詳推之，卯酉為二人之門，故為而作例。然十　二宫亦有管攝，須以吉凶辰論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392287006770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"之，可以意㑹。在𫑗酉日辰上見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"福官入宫，須分彼此，若作令神，富貴無比，不令不尅，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"可為喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡官福星入命者，分其生尅，若能助其光輝者大吉。又作令神，則全美星光輝相助。若不是令星，旣無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"尅制，則亦為吉，終是福官之星，可喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"日取陽曜，夜取光芒。殿居四實，官坐廟廊。若處飛馬，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"奔夜忙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"如命係日中生，衆星入命。雖有尅制，亦分彼此。夜生人有光之星入命為通機。在實地當成名。若居飛馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561003042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":613,"lineType":2,"content":"奔走不閑。飛馬者，以日時起之，即申子辰馬在寅之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"陰忌計土，不分南北。已午未申，限元無力。若居酉辰，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"虎而翼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰。若與土計同宫，惟辰酉二宫相生，他宫同處，皆不為美限。若又行已午未申之地，則全然作凶論主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"夭折。若土計坐處値空，則不相妨，謂土計値空也。其不凶可知。若己午未申之地不空，其凶不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"大格五經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"大格者，大全格也。五經者，曰獨歩摘金歌、難經總斷論碎金也。其閒𤣥妙之語，摘金難經獨歩總論。雖少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"異於人，反説之。不知其義者，可于大格中例推之。然奴貌相宫，何異于人？非口訣安知其義？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393247244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神、吉神、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"諸凶煞諸喜神，不可不考。當考其直年為上。又有時候，不可輕斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"令星毋曜，實處為隣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"令星者，春木夏火之𩔖。毋曜者，如子宫命土主火為母星之𩔖。如星得令相關命主相宜同處者，為上格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"之命。限元中亦看，可推得令之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水土，寅亥巳申。順則富貴，刑則天貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"四星於四刑之中，相有相關，神妙莫測。如亥中有水，巳中有木，寅中有水，申中有木，如遇土金犯之，致富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"致貴。凡人皆以寅亥不宜見金，豈知其中有生水之妙。己中見土，有生金之義。若見刑尅則凶。忽遇流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399543087142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"致刑尅，亦不為祥。遇刑遇衝遇天空，則為妙處論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"留心考究，傳宜得人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"凡五星，須當留心細推空亡、刑尅、虚實，方得其驗。如不驗，必其生時之差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
